Electro-hydraulic manifold assembly with lead frame mounted pressure sensors
(57)
An electro-hydraulic manifold assembly with a
plurality of solenoid operated valves (16-26) disposed
on a manifold block (12) and each operable to control
pressure from the inlet to a separate outlet. Sensing
ports are provided in each outlet with a pressure sensor
(32-40) sealed over the sensing port for providing a sig-
nal indicative of the sensed pressure. The pressure sen-
sors are mounted on a lead frame (14) and connected
to conductive strips in the lead frame. The lead frame
has slots therein which permit the frame to be simulta-
neously electrically connected by bayonet connection to
the terminals on each solenoid valve as the transducers
are sealed over the sensing ports and the lead frame
attached to the manifold block.

Claims
1.
An electro-hydraulic manifold assembly compris-
ing:
(a) a manifold block (12) having an inlet port
communicating with a plurality of valving cham-
bers (42-50, 102, 104), with each chamber hav-
ing a discrete outlet port (56-66), 110) and a
pressure sensing port (134-142) communicat-
ing with each outlet port;
(b) an electrically operated valve (16-26, 28,
30) disposed to control pressure in each of said
chambers between said inlet port and the re-
spective discrete outlet port;
(c) a lead frame (14) disposed on said block
having a plurality of sets of electrical terminals
(200-224), with each set making electrical con-
nection with one of said valves, the lead frame
including a plurality of pressure transducers
(32-40) with each transducer located thereon
so as to be positioned for communicating re-
spectively with one of said pressure sensing
ports; and,
(d) means (252-256) operative for securing
said lead frame to said block.
2.
The assembly defined in claim 1, wherein at least
one of said valves is solenoid operated.
3.
The manifold assembly defined in claim 1, wherein
each of said pressure transducers comprises a die
(340) electrically connected to conductors (32'-40',
340') on said lead frame.
4.
The manifold assembly defined in claim 1, wherein
said lead frame has the said sets of electrical ter-
minals arranged for bayonet type connection with
said valves.
5.
The manifold assembly defined in claim 1, wherein
said sets of electrical terminals and said pressure
transducers are connected to a common receptacle
(240) on said lead frame for external electrical con-
nection thereto.
6.
The manifold assembly defined in claim 1, wherein
said pressure transducers have leads (344) at-
tached to pads (340', 32'-40')formed on electrical
conductors on said lead frame.
7.
A method of making an electro-hydraulic manifold
assembly comprising:
(a) providing a block (12) and forming an inlet
passage and a plurality of spaced valving
chambers (42-52, 102, 104) each having a dis-
crete outlet passage (42-52, 110) in the block
communicating therewith with a sensing port
(134-142) formed in each outlet passage;
(b) forming an electrical lead frame (14) with a
plurality of sensing orifices (348) thereon each
located to align with one of the sensing ports;
(c) mounting an electrically operated valve
(16-31) in each valving chamber and porting
the valve for controlling pressure from the inlet
passage to the respective discrete outlet;
(d) mounting a pressure transducer (32-40)
over each of said sensing orifices in said lead
